scope: Read-only analysis of saved network evidence; no new molecule submissions

findings.failure_body: Same169-byte nginx/1.20.1 error body on all six429s
findings.successful_response: 302 application redirect; application security headers present
findings.failed_response: 429, application security headers absent; no Retry-After or rate-limit headers
findings.size_comparison: Direct successful10-molecule form753bytes; proxy failed10-molecule form757bytes. No evidence of a simple fixed10-molecule or body-size ceiling.
findings.curl_format: Same code path and form fields succeeded once; no evidence of an unconditional curl ban or malformed-form explanation.

localization: Evidence points to a server-side nginx/front-end gate or interception; it does not prove which component originally generated the429.
unresolved_hypotheses: Global endpoint/server/concurrency limit shared by clients
Incorrect real-client-IP forwarding causing a shared limiter key
Security filtering or proxy egress reputation
A per-client rule keyed on something other than public IP
important_limit: The three distinct proxy exit IPs were measured at ip-info.com, not the failed ADMETlab POSTs. Exact origin-observed IPs and limiting keys require provider/server logs.
